connectorUiConfig.title: Darktrace SecureAI Unified Agent Risk
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Darktrace SecureAI](https://darktrace.com) connector pushes normalized agent risk alerts directly into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push pattern and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. Events are written to the `UnifiedAgentRisk_CL` table.

graphQueries.metricName: Total unified agent risk events received

sampleQueries.description: Get the latest Darktrace SecureAI unified agent risk events
sampleQueries.query:
UnifiedAgentRisk_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

dataTypes.name: UnifiedAgentRisk_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
UnifiedAgentRisk_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create Azure resources and provide the required permissions
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables Darktrace SecureAI to push unified agent risk alerts directly to Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated configuration and secure data ingestion with a Microsoft Entra application
Selecting **Deploy push connector resources** creates the `UnifiedAgentRisk_CL` Log Analytics table, a data collection rule (DCR), and a data collection endpoint (DCE). It also creates a Microsoft Entra application, grants it access to the DCR, and configures a client secret so Darktrace SecureAI can send events securely.
